candidate.answerReason: Random selection from every grade includes the school's different grade groups. Selecting only athletes, one grade, or volunteers risks an unrepresentative sample.

methods.label: Representativeness and random selection
methods.explanation: The sample should be representative, covering all grade levels with random selection. B, C, and D would all bias the sample toward a particular group of students.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 sample representativeness and random sampling, within the Grade 8 scope.
